text.arabic_uthmani: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنشِـُٔونَ

words.gloss_range: interrogative particle fused to an independent second-person plural pronoun; fronted addressee under rhetorical challenge

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the disjunctive hinge that completes the opening interrogative frame
the opposed divine pronoun in the second limb

words.prose: {{ar:ءَأَنتُمْ}} ({{tr:ʾa-antum}}) begins with the addressees themselves before any verb names the act, so human agency is isolated for cross-examination rather than simply mentioned as a verbal subject. The opening hamza keeps the first limb under question until {{ar:أَمْ}} ({{tr:am}}) supplies the second alternative, making the ayah a forced agency binary: you, or We. Its fused surface joins the interrogative challenge to the pronoun, and the accepted double-hamza and softened-hamza realizations leave that interrogative-pronoun frame intact. As the final reprise of the challenge formula also seen at 56:59, 56:64, and 56:69, the word makes the fire-tree question another direct test of claimed human origination.

topics.headline: fronted addressee is put on trial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not merely ask whether humans acted; it first isolates the addressed humans as the agency being tested.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence parse the word as an explicit fronted second-person plural pronoun functioning as the subject of the following Form IV verb.

topics.headline: opening hamza waits for the am alternative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first word opens a question whose force is not complete until the later alternative locks the listener into a two-agent choice.
topics.reason: The opening interrogative particle and the later connected disjunction form the licensed rhetorical-question frame.

topics.headline: interrogative and pronoun are fused at the surface
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the challenge is attached to the addressee in the very word-form, while recitational variation changes phonetic sharpness without changing the grammatical challenge.
topics.reason: The interrogative-plus-pronoun analysis survives, but claims about a double-glottal jolt must be limited because accepted readings can soften the second hamza.

topics.headline: final reprise of the addressee formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this opening repeats the surah's earlier challenge pattern (56:59, 56:64, 56:69), now applying it to the tree that enables fire.
topics.reason: The attachment cross-reference identifies this as the fourth instance of the formulaic challenge frame anchored at 56:59.

words.root_gloss_range: arising, beginning, growing, raising, producing, and causing to originate; local Form IV selects caused origination rather than ordinary kindling

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the explicit object whose origination is challenged

words.prose: {{ar:أَنشَأْتُمْ}} ({{tr:anshaʾtum}}) is a Form IV perfect with {{ar:شَجَرَتَهَآ}} ({{tr:shajaratahā}}) as its explicit object, so the question is not whether the audience can kindle fire but whether they caused the fire's tree-source to arise. The 2mp ending repeats the already fronted addressees, making human agency emphatically exposed and deniable. The root field of beginning, arising, growing, raising, and producing keeps the object as a living generated structure, while the Form IV morphology focuses that field into external causation. Within the surah, the same root links this challenge to divine origination language at 56:35, 56:61, and 56:62; wider creation uses at 23:14, 21:56, and 29:20 keep the local tree question inside a larger origination register. The finite human perfect is then set up for reversal by the closing definite participial title, where the same root becomes an enduring divine attribution.

topics.headline: the object is the fire's tree-source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the challenged act is specifically originating the fire's tree-source, not merely making or lighting fire.
topics.reason: The verb is transitive in this clause and governs the following accusative noun as its explicit direct object.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from observed human kindling to a grammatically exposed human claim that can be denied.
topics.reason: The perfect active 2mp verb carries the addressees as subject, while the independent pronoun has already fronted that same subject for emphasis.

topics.headline: Form IV makes arising a causative test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb asks who caused the tree to come into being, while the local object keeps the range tied to origination of this tree-source.
topics.reason: QAC identifies Form IV, supporting causative force; broader claims about instant creation, cultivation, or architecture are kept as root-range pressure rather than selected local senses.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb carries genesis and growth pressure, so the question reaches behind human technique to the emergence of the source itself.
topics.reason: The bundle has no V4 rows for this root, but QAC and contextual evidence confirm the local Form IV creation verb with an explicit object.

topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete same-surah and corpus references, and no guardrail evidence contradicts treating them as echo rather than local sense replacement.

words.prose: {{ar:شَجَرَتَهَآ}} ({{tr:shajaratahā}}) is the object that completes the first proposition: the question is whether the addressees originated the fire's own tree. Its suffix points back to {{ar:ٱلنَّارَ}} ({{tr:al-nār}}) in 56:71, so the previous visible fire is resolved into a dependent source, not left as a loose object of human use. The noun remains a concrete tree or woody fire-source, narrowed by the kindling setting, by the markh and ʿafār fire-drill specificity in the evidence, and by the tree-to-fire recurrence at 36:80; its singular possessed form can focus the fire-kindling source kind rather than one counted trunk. The root's branching and entanglement pressure makes that source feel structurally complex rather than inert fuel, while broader Quranic tree-language can carry sign-value across registers without displacing the local fire-source. Same-surah tree language at 56:52 is an echo, but it contrasts punitive zaqqūm imagery with the ordinary source humans handle here.

topics.headline: suffix makes it the fire's own tree
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the suffix carries the fire from 56:71 into 56:72 and turns it into a source-dependent object: its tree.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the 3fs suffix as resuming the previous feminine singular fire.

topics.reason: The noun is accusative as the direct object of the Form IV verb and is locally tied to the prior fire.

topics.headline: ordinary tree narrows into fire-source wood

topics.reason: V4 supports the tree or woody-plant branch, and the local context plus CRITICAL intertext points to fire-source wood.

topics.reason: V4 accepts both woody-plant and entangled-dispute branches, but the local noun and antecedent select the concrete tree branch; broader branching claims are kept as image pressure only.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the singular possessed noun can focus the generative source or fire-kindling kind, not merely one counted trunk.
topics.reason: The word is a feminine singular possessed noun, and the CRITICAL rows tie that form to the fire-source referent.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same surah's tree-language contrasts zaqqūm at 56:52 with the fire's ordinary tree-source at 56:72.

topics.reason: The previous fire-making verb and the current possessed tree noun are linked by the cross-ayah suffix and by the CRITICAL boundary rows.

words.gloss_range: connected disjunctive particle forming the second limb of a rhetorical binary

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the completed human-agency proposition before the pivot
the divine-agent proposition after the pivot

words.prose: {{ar:أَمْ}} ({{tr:am}}) is the hinge that makes the ayah one coordinated choice rather than two loose statements. It links the completed human-agency claim before it to {{ar:نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنشِـُٔونَ}} ({{tr:naḥnu al-munshiʾūna}}) after it, so the alternatives are two agents, not two objects or two unrelated questions. Local grammar supports connected {{ar:أَمْ}} ({{tr:am}}); the corrective, rather-like pressure survives only as rhetorical direction, because the second limb is the answer the structure pushes the listener to concede. The particle therefore turns the line into an exclusive comparison between challenged human origination and divine origination.

topics.headline: connected am joins the two limbs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle keeps the two clauses inside one interrogative frame and forces a two-term agency comparison.
topics.reason: QAC labels the particle as connected disjunction, and attachment evidence makes the second clause coordinated with the first.

topics.headline: the alternatives are human and divine agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the choice is not about methods of fire-making but about mutually exclusive agents of origination.
topics.reason: The particle stands between a fronted human pronoun and a fronted divine pronoun, with both sides tied to the same origination root.

topics.headline: corrective pressure serves the connected reading
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a rhetorical push toward the divine answer, while local syntax still treats the particle as coordinating the two alternatives.
topics.reason: The bundle's grammar identifies {{ar:أَمْ}} ({{tr:am}}) as connected in this clause; disconnected or corrective force can be retained only as rhetorical pressure, not as the governing parse.

topics.headline: fronted pronouns and am converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle's binary force works together with both fronted pronouns to exclude any third source for the tree's origination.
topics.reason: The ayah places a fronted second-person pronoun before the particle and a fronted first-person divine pronoun after it.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the predicate locked to the divine pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:نَحْنُ}} ({{tr:naḥnu}}) makes the divine speaker grammatically visible in the second limb rather than leaving the answer inside an implied subject. It mirrors the opening addressee pronoun, so the agency contrast is heard at pronoun level before the final predicate arrives: you, or We. As the subject of the nominal sentence with {{ar:ٱلْمُنشِـُٔونَ}} ({{tr:al-munshiʾūna}}), it identifies the speaker with origination rather than narrating a single timed act. Agreement with the plural predicate locks the final title to this divine self-reference, and the boundary from 56:71 to 56:72 moves from what humans do with fire to who truly originates its source.

topics.headline: the divine agent is overt
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the answer does not merely imply divine agency; it states the divine We over against the challenged human you.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as an independent first-person plural pronoun, and attachment evidence places it as the subject of the nominal sentence.

topics.headline: nominal clause identifies, not just narrates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause presents origination as divine self-identification rather than only a past event report.
topics.reason: The pronoun is the subject of a nominal sentence whose predicate is the active participle.

topics.headline: agreement binds the final title to We
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final participial title is not detached; its plural predicate form is syntactically bound to the divine pronoun.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence licenses predication between {{ar:نَحْنُ}} ({{tr:naḥnu}}) and the plural nominative active participle.

topics.headline: you and We form matched beats
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's contrast before the predicate lands, because the two independent pronouns occupy matching emphatic positions.
topics.reason: Both pronouns are independent and fronted within their respective limbs of the binary question.

topics.headline: human activity yields to divine self-reference
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse shift from human fire activity in 56:71 to the decisive divine subject in 56:72.
topics.reason: The previous ayah foregrounds human kindling, while this limb places the divine pronoun in subject position.

words.gloss_range: definite Form IV active participle predicate: the originators, those who cause to arise
words.root_gloss_range: arising, beginning, growing, raising, producing, and causing to originate; local active participle makes the causative agent title explicit

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the nominal subject whose predicate is this title
the earlier finite verb from the same root

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُنشِـُٔونَ}} ({{tr:al-munshiʾūna}}) closes the ayah not with another finite verb but with a definite Form IV active-participle title. As the predicate of {{ar:نَحْنُ}} ({{tr:naḥnu}}), it identifies the divine We as the originators, and its article, participial stem, and plural nominative ending fuse into a bound agent title. The morphology turns causing-to-arise into an agentive role: the ones who continually cause emergence from nonappearance or latency. The word answers {{ar:أَنشَأْتُمْ}} ({{tr:anshaʾtum}}) by shifting the same root from a denied human perfect verb into a divine nominal attribute. Its uniqueness as the only active-participle occurrence of this root in the supplied distribution makes the final title especially marked, even reserved for this rhetorical climax, while same-surah echoes at 56:35, 56:61, and 56:62 let the closing word culminate the surah's origination chain. Together, the fronted pronouns, the disjunctive pivot, nominal predication, and root echo converge so the final word carries the agency verdict rather than a standalone label.

topics.headline: definite participle seals the answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah resolves the binary with a definite title, not just another event verb.
topics.reason: QAC parses the word as a definite active participle in nominative predicate position after the divine pronoun.

topics.headline: plural agreement binds the title to We
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final title is a bound predicate of the divine pronoun, with article, participial stem, and plural nominative ending working together.
topics.reason: The noun instance is masculine plural nominative and definite, and attachment evidence identifies it as the predicate of {{ar:نَحْنُ}} ({{tr:naḥnu}}).

topics.headline: causing-to-arise becomes an agent role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that origination is presented as an agentive identity: those who cause emergence from nonappearance or latency.
topics.reason: The word is the Form IV active participle of the same root used earlier in the ayah, functioning as a nominal predicate.

topics.headline: the participial form is uniquely marked
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing active participle is distributionally rare against the root's more common finite-verb uses, making the title-form stand out.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the NOUN_ACTIVE_PART instance count as one, while the PV Form IV profile has multiple instances.

topics.headline: same root shifts from denied verb to title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ear-level answer: the root first appears in a challenged human verb, then returns as the divine predicate.
topics.reason: Both words share the root and Form IV derivational field, but the first is a finite perfect and the second a definite active participle.

topics.headline: the title culminates the surah's root chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that after origination language at 56:35, 56:61, and 56:62, the final word of this ayah raises the root into an explicit agent title.
topics.reason: The supplied CRITICAL rows identify same-surah occurrences and no guardrail evidence blocks treating them as lexical echo.

topics.headline: human technique depends on the deeper originator
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the scene moves from human fire extraction to the permanent source behind the tree that enabled it.
topics.reason: The second predicate has an omitted object recoverable from the first limb, so the final title answers the earlier tree-origination question.

topics.headline: syntax, pivot, and root echo converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no single feature carries the verdict alone; pronoun fronting, the disjunctive pivot, nominal predication, and root echo combine to identify the divine originators.
topics.reason: The ayah's syntax isolates the agents, the particle coordinates the binary, and the repeated root links the challenged verb to the final predicate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled ن ش ء at words 2 and 6 places ش ج ر at word 3 inside a direct contrast between a second-person act and a first-person-plural agent noun.
baseline_models.mechanism: The origination branch of ن ش ء and the trunked-tree branch of ش ج ر make the question an agency distinction: possessing or handling a tree is not the same as causing it to come into existence.

activation_trace.role: Origination and bringing into existence supply the causal act whose agent the paired clause contests.
The ordinary trunked tree fixes that contested origination on a living material object.

changed_reading.before: A question asking whether people made its tree.
changed_reading.after: A question separating human access to the tree from the deeper agency that originates the living tree itself.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَنشَأْتُمْ and ٱلْمُنشِـُٔونَ can govern the temporal development of شَجَرَتَهَا, not only its first instant.
baseline_models.mechanism: The upbringing and growth branch of ن ش ء turns the tree into a process that is raised through stages; the contrast asks who carries that living development to maturity.

activation_trace.role: Upbringing and maturation extend the verb across a developmental process rather than a single manufacturing event.
The trunked plant supplies the organism whose staged growth must be sustained.

changed_reading.before: The issue is who fabricated the tree.
changed_reading.after: The issue is who reared and grew it through the stages by which it became a standing tree.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus repeats ن ش ء around the tree, allowing the action to be heard as the tree's rising as well as its beginning.
baseline_models.mechanism: The elevation branch of ن ش ء joins the trunked form of ش ج ر to construe origination spatially: emergence becomes an upward standing-forth.

activation_trace.role: Rising and elevation give origination a vertical trajectory.
The stemmed tree embodies the result as an elevated, standing growth.

changed_reading.before: The tree is a finished thing that was made.
changed_reading.after: The tree is an emergence made to rise and stand, with the question directed to the source of that upward becoming.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creative origination and repeated attention prompts place the focus inside a sequence of observable operations whose surface human act is tested against a deeper originating agent.

activation_trace.role: The focus verb names origination and is the local act assigned by the human-or-divine contrast.
Creative bringing-into-existence gives the earlier mirrored question the same causal depth as the focus.
The alerting and interrogative use of أفرأيتم opens the immediately adjacent evidence station and directs attention to what humans actually do.

structural_cues: 56:59 duplicates the focus pattern أأنتم plus a finite verb, أم نحن, and a matching agent noun.
56:58, 56:63, 56:68, and 56:71 repeatedly introduce concrete evidence stations with أفرأيتم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creative origination, an attention command, and repeated syntax; I infer that recurrence turns 56:72 into one station in an empirical agency audit. A live alternative is that each question remains an independent example without a single formal audit.

changed_reading.before: An isolated challenge about the making of one tree.
changed_reading.after: A controlled agency test: the addressee is made to compare a visible human operation with the unperformed act of originating its enabling source.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured death, substitution, renewed origination, and first origination turn the focus tree from a one-time product into visible evidence of agency over ordered emergence across discontinuity and altered forms.

activation_trace.role: The focus's act of origination is the concrete instance expanded into a repeatable capacity.
Deliberate ordering by measure supplies governance of the transition rather than accidental succession.
Loss of life and force supplies the discontinuity across which renewed origination is asserted.
One thing standing in another's place makes altered succession, not simple persistence, part of the mechanism.
The same origination branch directly extends the focus root to an unknown form of renewed bringing-into-being.
Beginning and precedence mark a first origination that can serve as evidence for further origination.

structural_cues: 56:60-62 moves in order from measured death to replacement, origination in an unknown form, and recollection of the first origination.
The context occurrence of ن ش ء in 56:61 repeats the focus verb before the focus repeats it twice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered transitions and repeated origination root; I infer that the tree is presented as an observable instance of capacity to originate again across changed conditions. The alternative is that the tree merely starts a new set of material examples after the earlier claim has closed.

changed_reading.before: The question concerns who first produced this particular tree.
changed_reading.after: The tree's emergence is evidence of a governed, repeatable power to originate forms across death, substitution, and unfamiliar renewal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence distinguishes preparatory work and casting seed from actual germination and increase; this sharpens ن ش ء as the living development that human cultivation occasions but does not autonomously execute.

activation_trace.role: Upbringing and growth name the sustained biological process whose agency is under examination.
The trunked plant is the mature result that exposes the gap between preparation and living increase.
Casting seed and working the crop supply the real but preparatory human operation.
Germination and growth supply the causally deeper process claimed in the mirrored agent contrast.

structural_cues: 56:63 first names what the addressees cultivate, then 56:64 asks with the same human-or-divine pattern who makes it grow.
The tree in 56:72 is the developed plant-form downstream of the cultivation sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct cultivation and germination branches in consecutive ayat; I infer a division between human preparation and living increase. A live alternative is that both roots broadly denote farming and the sequence stresses agency without a technical process boundary.

changed_reading.before: Humans appear plausible makers because they plant and tend trees.
changed_reading.after: Human cultivation is acknowledged as preparation, while the tree's staged germination, increase, and maturation remain the origination being contested.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent fire and the image of concealed fire drawn out by striking recast the tree as a material carrier of latent combustibility; originating the tree includes establishing a system from which humans can elicit fire without having authored its capacity.

activation_trace.role: Origination assigns agency over the existence of the combustible source, not merely over an ignition event.
Interlocking, load-bearing wood makes the tree legible as material structure capable of carrying and yielding another process.
Kindled fire supplies the manifested effect whose material source is named in the focus.
Fire hidden in a striker and brought out supplies the extraction pattern: human elicitation reveals a capacity already lodged in material.

structural_cues: 56:71 asks about the fire the addressees kindle immediately before 56:72 names شجرتها with a feminine possessive that can refer back to النار.
The sequence moves from the visible act of kindling to the prior existence of the tree that enables it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent fire, a concealed-fire extraction image, and a wooden carrier; I infer that the tree embodies an embedded combustible affordance authored before human ignition. The alternative is a narrower botanical reading in which the question concerns only who grew the relevant tree.

changed_reading.before: The tree is simply the fuel people use to make fire.
changed_reading.after: The tree is a created carrier of latent fire-capacity: people can elicit the effect, but that elicitation does not make them authors of the material affordance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired counterfactuals of crop reduced to fragments and water made bitter add preservation and usable quality to origination: the tree is not only begun but maintained in a materially serviceable state.

activation_trace.role: Origination is revised from a punctual beginning into the upstream cause of an extant, usable source.
The living tree is the material whose integrity and fitness could fail.
Will directed toward a thing supplies contingency rather than material inevitability.
Making something enter another state supplies the causal transition from viable growth to ruin.
Dry matter broken into fragments supplies the failed state against which the tree's integrity becomes salient.
Bitter saline water supplies a second case where an available material can be rendered unfit for its human use.

structural_cues: 56:65 and 56:70 repeat لو نشاء plus جعلناه before the focus's agency question.
Both counterfactuals alter the usability of a material humans normally take as given.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine-will counterfactuals and two ruined material states; I infer that the focus's origination includes preservation of the tree's usable constitution. The live alternative is that the counterfactuals only teach gratitude and do not extend the lexical scope of ن ش ء.

changed_reading.before: The question asks who began the tree's existence.
changed_reading.after: It also asks who keeps the tree from becoming failed matter and gives it the stable material fitness on which human use depends.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayah makes the manifested fire a reminder and practical resource in barren conditions; the focus tree therefore becomes upstream provisioning infrastructure whose origination enables portable benefit beyond the place of growth.

activation_trace.role: Origination establishes the upstream source from which the downstream benefit becomes possible.
The trunked tree supplies renewable material that can be carried from growth into use.
Assigning the fire a resulting state links material origination to deliberate function.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies the cognitive function of the fire yielded through the tree.
A thing used for needs and sufficiency supplies the practical function downstream of the tree.
The barren, resource-poor place supplies the condition in which portable fire-provision becomes especially consequential.

structural_cues: 56:73 immediately follows the focus and assigns the feminine referent both mnemonic and practical functions.
The sequence runs from kindling, to the tree's origination, to the resulting fire's use.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the adjacent causal order, assigned functions, and scarcity branch; I infer an upstream chain from originated tree to elicited fire to mobile provision. The alternative is that 56:73 describes fire alone and does not characterize the purpose of the tree's origination.

changed_reading.before: The tree is only an object whose maker is disputed.
changed_reading.after: Its origination is the first stage of a provisioning chain that yields both recollection and practical benefit where ordinary resources are absent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers fire and tillage vocabulary into social conflict, but it remains anchored in the focus branches for initiating speech or action and entangled dispute, while the context independently supplies stirring war and a feud among people. Downstream prose should present it only as a social-material echo of the literal tree-and-fire reading, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ن ش ء can mark beginning a saying or act, while ش ج ر can mark interwoven quarrel; together they permit the focus wording to echo the initiation of an entangled conflict.

activation_trace.role: Beginning speech or action supplies the ignition-like initiation of a social process.
Interwoven quarrel and mixed speech supply the conflict that can spread after initiation.
Stirring fire or war bridges material cultivation to deliberate agitation of conflict.
A feud or enmity among people supplies the social fire adjacent to the focus.

changed_reading.before: The addressees are asked whether they produced a literal tree.
changed_reading.after: As a contained echo, they are also confronted with whether they truly originate the entangled conflicts they appear to kindle, or only activate conditions whose deeper agency exceeds them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because camel conception, semen-as-seed, and genealogical origin are carried into an arboreal object. It remains valid as an analogy because both focus roots themselves supply gestation and lineage branches, and the nearby sequence supplies reproductive material and seed imagery. Downstream prose should qualify it as a generative-lineage resonance and retain the literal tree as primary.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus can pair the pregnancy-beginning branch of ن ش ء with the origin or lineage branch of ش ج ر, making the visible tree the unfolding of an implanted generative source.

activation_trace.role: The beginning of pregnancy supplies an internally initiated growth that later becomes visible.
Tree as origin or lineage lets the plant stand for a branching generative descent.
Reproductive fluid from which form is apportioned supplies the concealed material beginning of developed life.
Semen construed as seed joins human generation to the packet's agricultural growth sequence.

changed_reading.before: The tree is a discrete botanical product.
changed_reading.after: As a contained generative resonance, the tree is a branching lineage whose hidden implantation and unfolding raise the same question of originating agency as animal or human development.

strongest_changes: The repeated أأنتم ... أم نحن pattern turns the focus from an isolated assertion into a controlled comparison between visible human handling and originating agency.
The cultivation sequence sharply distinguishes preparatory work from germination and sustained growth, strengthening the developmental force of ن ش ء.
The adjacent concealed-fire and provision branches recast the tree as upstream material infrastructure carrying a latent capacity that humans elicit but do not author.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's doubled origination root sits between a living tree and a mirrored agent contrast, allowing temporal growth, material affordance, and repeated re-origination to coexist without collapsing into one reading; the same inventories also preserve unusually coherent conflict and lineage echoes.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the focus weights absolute origination, organic upbringing, or upward emergence most heavily remains open.
The hidden-fire branch of و ر ي supports an extraction model, but treating the whole tree as designed storage is still a reader-supplied causal extension.
The conflict and generative-lineage outliers are branch-resolvable but remain analogical and should not displace the literal botanical reading.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The fire’s tree is an originated support, not a human invention.** Repeated `ن ش ء` activates **B006**, bringing into being; `ش ج ر` **B001** supplies woody plant and **B004** interlaced wooden support. The possessive pronoun binds tree to fire. **Abductive move:** I infer that the material support storing ignition is part of the creative chain. **Reading change:** the question moves agency one stage behind kindling to the production of its enabling medium.

2. **Growth and flame joined through one created structure.** `ن ش ء` **B001** supplies rising and being raised, while `ش ج ر` **B009** supplies stock or origin as a tree. **Abductive move:** I infer that the growing tree is the lineage or stock from which later flame emerges. **Reading change:** apparently opposed living growth and consuming fire become phases of one originated potential.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The protected book and descending recitation at 56:77–80 made the tree’s hidden-fire structure a material analogue for latent content becoming accessible.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The origin question moves behind the spark to the growth that stores its possibility.** Verb and agent noun repeat `ن ش ء` (B006, bringing into being with formation), taking `ش ج ر` (B001, woody plant with a stem) as the fire’s possessed source. Ayat 67–71 move from deprivation through water to human kindling; ayat 73–77 state fire’s reminder and use, command praise, and attach a great oath to a noble recitation. The packet supplies the tree as belonging to the fire and an exclusive origin contrast; I infer that the instrument’s efficacy depends on a prior material architecture humans did not originate. The causal inquiry recedes one layer behind visible ignition.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 56:77–80 extends the upstream-source inquiry from material means to noble recitation, protected inscription, and lordly descent, showing that transmitted speech also retains an origin beyond its handlers.

concept_map.definition: Sabit gece ifadesi, kaynağa göre geceleyin Tanrı'ya yönelmek için ayağa kalkmayı ya da gecenin başlangıcı, bütün saatleri, uykudan sonraki bölümü veya gece içinde ortaya çıkan iyi işleri gösterebilir. Bu yorumlar seçeneklidir ve tek bir zaman sınırında birleşmez.

Başka yorumlar ifadeyi gecenin ilk saatleri, bütün gece saatleri veya gece içinde başlayan iyi işler olarak açıklar.
Daha dar bir yorum, gecenin uyku sonrasında kalan bölümünü veya o sırada gerçekleşen kalkışı belirtir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi üç bağlı mızrak kuruluşunu açıkça destekler: savaşçıların mızraklarla çarpışması, mızrakların birbirine geçmesi ve birine mızrak saplanması. Bunların hiçbiri yalın kökün genel anlamı olarak genişletilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız mızrakla çarpışma, mızrakların iç içe geçmesi ve mızrakla saplama kuruluşlarını kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Mızraklı savaşta tarafların birbirine mızrak saplaması ve mızrakların çarpışırken iç içe geçmesidir; tek kişiye yönelen kuruluşta ise mızrakla saplamayı anlatır.

facets.statement: Karşılaşan taraflar mızraklarla birbirlerine saplama yaparak çarpışır.
Çarpışma sırasında mızraklar birbirinin arasına girer ve iç içe geçer.
Tek nesneli kuruluş, bir kişiye mızrak saplamayı bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar mızraklı karşılaşmada karşılıklı saplamayı ve mızrakların iç içe geçmesini, ayrıca tek hedefe mızrak saplama kuruluşunu birlikte destekler.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklı çarpışmayı, mızrakların iç içe geçmesini ve tek hedefe saplamayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki tarafın mızraklarla birbirine girdiği karşılıklı savaş bağlamında uygundur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylemin tek bir hedefe mızrakla saplama bildirdiği kuruluş içindir.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli bir hedefe mızrakla saplama eylemini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir nesne değil, bir araya getirilen ya da yerleştirilen ağaç parçalarının taşıma, dayama, asma ve engelleme görevleri üstlendiği bir nesne ailesi verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak tanım bu işlev çeşitlerini ortak bir ahşap düzenek çekirdeğine bağlamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal canlı bitkiyi değil, taşıyan, dayayan, asan ya da engelleyen ahşap parçaları ve düzenekleri adlandırır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Adlar yalın biçimde ahşap nesne ve düzenekleri karşılar; başka dallardaki bitki ya da eylem kuruluşları buraya aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir araya getirilmiş ya da belirli bir yere konmuş ağaç parçalarından oluşan taşıyıcı, dayanak, askı veya engeldir. Tahtırevan iskeleti, kuyu ve kapı ağaçları, giysi askısı ve yavrunun emmesini önleyen ağız çubuğu bu aileye girer.

facets.statement: Ağaç parçaları bir şeyi taşımak, dayamak, asmak ya da geçişi engellemek üzere yerleştirilir veya birleştirilir.
Birleşik ağaçlar tahtırevan ve benzeri insan taşıyan araçların iskeletini oluşturabilir.
Tek parça ya da düzenek, kapı ve kuyuda dayanak veya engel, evde direk ya da giysi askısı olabilir.
Yavrunun anasını emmesini önlemek için ağzına konan çubuk, engelleme işlevinin özel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir araya getirilen ya da yerleştirilen ağaçların taşıt iskeleti, dayanak, askı ve engel olarak kullanıldığı nesne ailesini çeşitli örneklerle destekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın farklı nesnelerini malzeme, düzenlenme ve işlev ortaklığıyla birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Ahşap malzemeyi, birleştirme veya yerleştirmeyi ve dört temel işlevi korur.

Bir kuruluş, kişinin elini çenesinin altına koyup başını eline dayamasını anlatır.
Başka bir kuruluş, ağza çubuk sokarak ağzı açık duruma getirmeyi anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi resim veya desenin ağaç görünüşüne göre yapılmasını ve bu niteliğin ipekli kumaş üzerindeki özel kullanımını açıkça destekler. Bitkinin kendisi ile aynı biçimin askı anlamı dal dışında bırakılmıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal gerçek ağacı değil, ağaç biçiminde yapılmış resim veya deseni ve bu desenli kumaşı anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın türemiş biçim ağaç biçimli resmi, kumaş kuruluşu ise yalnız ağaç desenli ipekli kumaşı bildirir.

concept_map.definition: Ağaç görünüşü örnek alınarak yapılmış resim veya desendir; kumaşa bağlı kullanımda yüzeyi böyle bir ağaç deseniyle işlenmiş ipekli kumaşı anlatır.

facets.statement: Resim ya da desen, ağacın biçimini veya genel görünüşünü yeniden üretir.
İpekli kumaşın yüzeyindeki işleme veya desen ağaç görünüşündedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ağaç biçiminde yapılmış resim ve deseni ortak çekirdek olarak verir; ipekli kumaş üzerindeki ağaç desenini bunun özel uygulaması olarak destekler.

concept_gloss.text: ağaç biçimli resim ya da desen
concept_gloss.applicability: Genel görsel biçimi ve kumaş üzerindeki özel uygulamayı doğal ve kısa biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Ağacın örnek alınmasını ve sonucun resim ya da desen olmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir yüzeydeki resim veya bezemenin ağaç biçiminde olduğunu bildiren bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Desenin ağaç görünüşünü örnek alması anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ağaç görünüşünü genel bir desen ilkesi yapar; komşu dal hurma salkımı biçimine özgü tasviri ve başka figürleri de içeren ayrı bir adlandırmadır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Desenin belirleyici özelliği ağaç biçimini yeniden üretmesidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kısa ve yakın çizgileri, ince işlemeyi ve konusu ağaç olmak zorunda olmayan bezemeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: ağaç biçimli desen ile sık ince çizgili bezeme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kumaş veya başka bir yüzey üzerindeki bezeme ve desen alanında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı desenin konusu olan ağaç biçimi belirler; komşu dalı ise çizgilerin inceliği, yakınlığı ve genel süsleme işlemi belirler.
